title: Severe Weather Week Ahead, Oct 19 – Oct 26: Marginal Risk Monday #shorts
description:

Thu, Oct 22: Low chance

jue 22 de oct: Probabilidad baja
vie 23 de oct: Probabilidad baja

narration.text: Here's the severe weather outlook for the week ahead.
Monday kicks things off with a Marginal Risk.
Tuesday’s looking lovely, a day of calm weather.
Wednesday brings another Marginal Risk to watch.
Thursday offers a welcome break, quiet and clear.
Friday remains peaceful, with nothing to worry about.
Sunday promises more of the same calm.
Monday seems to be shaping up as another quiet day.
And, it appears Monday will be our most active day, showing a Marginal Risk.
narration.plain: The most active day looks like Monday, with a Marginal Risk.
